description: Source code for a Git negotiation algorithm, managing commit references and priority queue operations during fetch negotiations.

classes.name: entry
classes.description: Represents an entry in the priority queue, containing a commit and TTL information.

classes.name: data
classes.description: Holds the priority queue and count of non-common revisions during negotiation.

methods.name: compare
methods.description: Compares two commit entries by their commit date.

methods.name: rev_list_push
methods.description: Pushes a commit into the revision list with a specified mark.

methods.name: clear_marks
methods.description: Clears specific flags from commits referenced by refs.

methods.name: mark_common
methods.description: Marks a commit and its ancestors as common.

methods.name: push_parent
methods.description: Ensures parent commits are in the queue with correct flags and TTL.

methods.name: get_rev
methods.description: Retrieves the next revision to send based on priority queue.

methods.name: known_common
methods.description: Marks a commit as known to be common.

methods.name: add_tip
methods.description: Adds a commit as a tip in the negotiation.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Gets the next revision to process.

methods.name: ack
methods.description: Acknowledges receipt of a commit and marks it as common.

methods.name: release
methods.description: Releases resources associated with the negotiation.
